quotations.old_english: Ealle þing synt mid Gode eáðelíce
quotations.english: with God all things are possible

source_text: eáðelic, ǽðelíc; comp. m. -lícra; f. n. -lícre: adj. Easy, possible; f&a-short;c&i-short;lis:-- Ealle þing synt mid Gode eáðelíce with God all things are possible, Mt. Bos. 19, 26. Hwæt is eáðelícre what is easier? 9, 5. DER. un-eáðelíc. v. ǽðe-líc.
